body:
A typo on my end, meant `||` (Or) instead, will update the code shortly after fixing the tests. Thanks for pointing this out @AThousandShips 😄

**EDIT**: Also it's either a valid ObjectID, or a null one (see impl. of `get_object` method), could be shorten to `!obj_id.is_null()`.
Yeah `!is_valid() || !is_null()` is always true, so just do `is_valid()`
Applied suggestion in latest force-pushed commit ([link to changes](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/compare/adeca5a853b38cd9f6e11668d32e411e88385cb9..03c0c2795571894fa717dc2849a3aa4fb9e19dbe))
